title: test: add economy smoke for ledger safety
body:
## Summary

Thêm `pnpm smoke:economy` để verify các invariant kinh tế trước khi mở rộng Phase 10 content scale (items/skills/missions/boss pack).

`scripts/smoke-economy.mjs` (~470 dòng ESM, zero new dep — chỉ native `fetch` + `AbortController` Node 20+) chạy 20 step end-to-end qua HTTP (`/api/_auth/*`, `/api/character/*`, `/api/daily-login/*`, `/api/shop/*`, `/api/inventory`, `/api/logs/me?type=currency|item`) verify các invariant trong [`docs/ECONOMY_MODEL.md`](docs/ECONOMY_MODEL.md) §3:

- **Single mutation point**: Sau mỗi mutation (daily-login claim, shop buy), `SUM(CurrencyLedger.delta WHERE LINH_THACH) == Character.linhThach`. Nếu code bypass `currencyService.mutate` → diff > 0 → smoke fail.
- **Atomic transaction**: Shop buy ghi đồng thời 1 row `CurrencyLedger` (`reason=SHOP_BUY`, `delta=-totalPrice`, `currency=LINH_THACH`, `refType='NPC_SHOP'`, `refId=itemKey`) + 1 row `ItemLedger` (`reason=SHOP_BUY`, `qtyDelta=+qty`).
- **Idempotency anti double-claim**: Gọi `/daily-login/claim` 2 lần cùng ngày → lần 2 phải `claimed=false`, balance unchanged, ZERO ledger row mới.
- **Anti double-spend (atomic rollback)**: Buy 99 × `huyet_chi_dan` (= 2475 LT) khi balance ~75 LT → status ≠ 200, balance unchanged, ZERO `CurrencyLedger`/`ItemLedger` row mới.
- **Inventory ↔ ItemLedger consistency**: Per `(character, itemKey)`, `SUM(ItemLedger.qtyDelta) == SUM(InventoryItem.qty)`; mọi `qty >= 0`.
- **No negative currency**: `Character.linhThach >= 0` sau mọi step.

**Files changed**:

- `scripts/smoke-economy.mjs` (new, 470 LOC)
- `package.json` — thêm `"smoke:economy": "node scripts/smoke-economy.mjs"`
- `docs/AI_HANDOFF_REPORT.md` — bump Executive Summary (commit `c1437f6`, baseline 1959 vitest, next task `smoke:ws`); snapshot 9q-5; Recent Changes block.
- `docs/QA_CHECKLIST.md` — §10 mới `pnpm smoke:economy` (when-to-run, env, 20-step list, deferred sub-checks: mail/giftcode/mission double-claim, cross-character anomaly).
- `docs/RUN_LOCAL.md` — §7 thêm pointer "Smoke runtime end-to-end".

**`AI_HANDOFF_REPORT.md updated`** — yes (Executive Summary + snapshot 9q-5 + Recent Changes).

**Checks đã chạy** (local 30/4 ~21:47 UTC):

| Check | Status |
|---|---|
| `pnpm typecheck` | ✅ PASS |
| `pnpm lint` | ✅ PASS |
| `pnpm test` | ✅ PASS — 1959 vitest (1133 api + 238 shared + 588 web). Lưu ý: chạy với `unset WEB_PUBLIC_URL` nếu shell có `apps/api/.env` sourced (`email.service.test.ts` strict-check default URL — pre-existing, không liên quan PR). |
| `pnpm build` | ✅ PASS |
| `pnpm smoke:economy` | ✅ PASS — 20/20 step trong 633ms với real Postgres + Redis + API `:3000`. Chạy lại lần 2 (idempotent path daily-login `claimed=false`) cũng pass. |

**Smoke status**:

```
[smoke:economy] API base = http://localhost:3000, timeout = 10000ms
[smoke:economy] healthz ... OK
[smoke:economy] register ... OK
[smoke:economy] onboard ... OK
[smoke:economy] character/me — starting balance ... OK
[smoke:economy] logs/me?type=currency — empty for fresh user ... OK
[smoke:economy] logs/me?type=item — empty for fresh user ... OK
[smoke:economy] daily-login/me — status ... OK
[smoke:economy] daily-login/claim — first call ... OK
[smoke:economy] character/me — balance after daily-login ... OK
[smoke:economy] ledger sum == character balance (after daily) ... OK
[smoke:economy] daily-login/claim — second call (idempotency) ... OK
[smoke:economy] shop/npc — find buyable LINH_THACH item ... OK
[smoke:economy] shop/buy huyet_chi_dan — debit + credit ... OK
[smoke:economy] character/me — balance after buy ... OK
[smoke:economy] CurrencyLedger SHOP_BUY row — debit ... OK
[smoke:economy] ItemLedger SHOP_BUY row — credit ... OK
[smoke:economy] Inventory.qty == SUM(ItemLedger.qtyDelta) per item ... OK
[smoke:economy] shop/buy — anti double-spend (insufficient funds) ... OK
[smoke:economy] final: ledger sum == character balance ... OK
[smoke:economy] logout ... OK

[smoke:economy] done: 20 pass / 0 fail / 20 total in 633ms
```

**CI gating**: smoke không chạy trong CI flow (cần API + DB + Redis live cùng process; CI hiện chạy unit + Playwright build-artifact). Script là **manual/gated** — `docs/QA_CHECKLIST.md` §10 yêu cầu pre-merge cho mọi Phase 10 content PR + PR đụng `currency/inventory/shop/daily-login/mail/giftcode` service. `AI_HANDOFF_REPORT.md` snapshot 9q-5 ghi rõ **"Needs runtime smoke"** khi tag closed beta.

**Risk / Rollback**:

- **Risk**: low. Script chỉ tạo user mới qua `/api/_auth/register` (random email `smoke-econ-*@smoke.invalid`). Không đụng admin/payment/secret. Không migration. Không sửa runtime code. Không thay đổi vitest baseline.
- **Rollback**: 1 commit revert (xóa `scripts/smoke-economy.mjs`, gỡ `package.json` entry, revert 3 docs file). Không có DB state để rollback (smoke tạo user mới, không đụng dữ liệu sẵn có).

**Next recommended task**: `pnpm smoke:ws` — realtime gateway smoke (cookie auth → connect → `cultivate:tick` / `mission:progress` / `chat:msg` push → throttle 500ms → reconnect). Pattern giống `smoke:economy` (zero-install, pure HTTP/WS, gated manual).

## Review & Testing Checklist for Human

Risk profile: 🟢 **green** — pure additive (1 script + 1 root pkg entry + 3 docs); không touch runtime code; không migration. Vitest baseline 1959 unchanged.

- [ ] Verify `pnpm smoke:economy` PASS local (cần `pnpm infra:up` + `prisma migrate deploy` + `bootstrap` + `pnpm --filter @xuantoi/api dev` ở tab khác).
- [ ] Đọc `scripts/smoke-economy.mjs` block JSDoc đầu file (lines 1-50) — verify scope đúng (chỉ ledger/reward safety, không gameplay flow).
- [ ] Đọc `docs/QA_CHECKLIST.md` §10 — verify pass/fail criteria + when-to-run rule khớp với expectation team trước Phase 10 content PR.

### Notes

- Smoke deliberately không cover mail/giftcode double-claim — cần admin login (secret `INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD`). Defer cho session sau (cùng `smoke:admin`). Unit tests `mail.service.test.ts` + `giftcode-race.test.ts` đã cover invariants tương đương.
- `pnpm --filter @xuantoi/api audit:ledger` (read-only, scan all) bổ trợ cho `smoke:economy` (mutates 1 user) — chạy định kỳ trên staging/prod để bắt cross-user anomaly.
- Web vitest 555 → 588 (33 test mới) là từ các PR session 9q trước (đã merge), KHÔNG liên quan PR này.
- Test failure `email.service.test.ts > uses custom WEB_PUBLIC_URL` chỉ xuất hiện khi shell sourced `apps/api/.env` trước khi `pnpm test` — đây là pre-existing test isolation issue, không phải regression PR này. Run trong clean env (hoặc `env -u WEB_PUBLIC_URL pnpm test`) sẽ pass full 1959.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/6f03cdf6da5343b291211c9d5b1f7cfc
Requested by: @hoathienmenh-01
